figures.caption: Table 1: Summary table of the theorems in this paper for bounding µ(m) using (σ (k) 1 , σ (k) 0 ) for a single k. All bounds reported in this table are sharp. Nontrivial bounds for even m mean that the resulting bounds are tighter than [0,∞], whereas nontrivial bounds for odd m mean that the resulting bounds are tighter than [−∞,∞]. LB denotes lower bound, and UB denotes upper bound.
Table 2: Summary statistics reported by [Moseley et al., 2002]. SD: standard deviation.

Table 3: Summary statistics reported by [Špirtović et al., 2023]. SD: standard deviation, Skew: skewness, Kurt: kurtosis, 2nd M: second central moments, 3rd M: third central moments, 4th M: fourth central moments. (We calculated 2nd M, 3rd M, and 4th M from their SD, Skew, and Kurt.)
